chunks: Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from Ibn Muskan, from al-Muthanna, from Abi Basir, from one of the two of them, peace be upon them.
Regarding the junub when he dies, he said: There is nothing upon him except a single washing.

key_terms.الْجُنُبِ: a person in the state of janabah requiring ghusl
key_terms.غَسْلَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ: a single washing, meaning one ghusl is sufficient
key_terms.لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ: there is no obligation upon him

ai.seo_question: If a person dies while in a state of janabah, is one ghusl enough?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a person who dies while in the state of janabah. It states that only one washing is required for the deceased, indicating that the funeral ghusl suffices in such a case.
